title: Justified by faith
gist: Paul's central teaching: no one is made right with God by the works of the law but by God's gift, received in faith. Abraham 'believed God, and it was reputed to him unto justice' (Genesis 15:6), and Paul says that is the pattern. The Catholic Church teaches that this faith is alive in love and brings real renewal, not only a change of status (Council of Trent).
original: Hebrew tsedaqah; Greek dikaiosyne, dikaioo ('to declare or make righteous').

passages.note: Not by the works of the law.
How faith is completed by works.
